events.text: In BIAN v14.0, the Term Deposit Service Domain maintains and exposes the operational state, balances, restrictions, entitlements, and lifecycle attributes associated with a specific AccountInstanceReference.

BIAN defines this SD as responsible for managing and exposing the live operational representation of a term deposit account instance. It follows the same implementation pattern as the Savings Account and Current Account SDs, with additional term-deposit–specific fields.
Classification: This is an Operational Account Instance domain — not a directory or contract domain.

rows: Term Deposit SD Does NOT Manage
Customer profile data — Party Directory SD
Account balances (available, incoming, outgoing, accrued interest)
Product agreement configuration — Sales Product Agreement SD
TD-specific fields: amount, duration, maturity date, open date

events.text: 2. When to Use This Service Domain
Invoke the Term Deposit SD whenever real-time term deposit account state must be retrieved or reflected in any consuming system or channel.

rows: Customer views term deposit on digital banking dashboard
Retrieve account state: balances, currency, status, parameters
UI displays deposit rules (tenure, penalties, interest rate)

events.text: Scenario: Customer logs into digital banking.
Action: Application retrieves account state through Term Deposit SD to display balances, currency, status, account details, and account parameters.
Scenario: User checks current deposit balance.
Action: System retrieves real-time data from GET /v1/balances/live, mapped to accountbalances[] in the BIAN payload.
Scenario: UI needs to display deposit rules such as tenure, penalty rates, and interest rates.
Action: Values sourced from entitlementoptiondefinition[] (product-level) and entitlementoptionsetting[] (account-level).

items: The bank operator can freeze or unfreeze an account, restricting all transactions to and from it.
This operation triggers when the update API is called and the fields for restriction templates and instances are populated.
Only the bank operator can initiate this operation; customers cannot request a freeze or unfreeze.
Only transactions are restricted on frozen accounts; customers can still access their accounts and view documents.
No notification is sent to customers when their accounts are frozen or unfrozen.
Instance-specific — all data must relate to the specific AccountInstanceReference.
Runtime accurate — balances and status sourced live from TM; no cached data.
Balance-aligned — balance types correctly mapped to TM posting phases including accrued interest.
Lifecycle-aware — OpenDate only populated when StatusReason = OPEN.
Externally sourced — all operational data sourced from four TM upstream APIs.

events.text: For each AccountInstanceReference (e.g. TD-ACC-556677), multiple records exist inside arrays:

rows: Product parameters from TM product versions (product level)
Account-level parameter overrides applied at Update

events.text: Term Deposit accounts include standard balance phases plus accrued interest types unique to this SD:
Debit/Credit Indicator Rule: amount > 0 => BalanceIndicator = Credit | amount < 0 => BalanceIndicator = Debit
The following TM parameters are applied at the account level (LEVEL_INSTANCE) and stored in entitlementoptionsetting[]:

rows: Target maturity date for the deposit
Fixed interest rate applied to the deposit
Day of month on which interest is applied
Maximum fee-free withdrawal as a percentage of deposit
POST /TermDeposit/Initiate → POST /v2/accounts with empty parameters and status ACCOUNT_STATUS_PENDING
TM returns account_id; orchestration layer triggers Update
POST /v1/parameter-values:batchCreate with TD-specific parameters from EntitlementOptionSetting[]

items: ACCOUNT_STATUS_PENDING — account created in CBS; TD parameters not yet applied.
ACCOUNT_STATUS_OPEN — account activated; TD parameters applied; fully operational.

events.text: These fields are unique to the Term Deposit SD and are not present in Savings or Current Account implementations:

rows: Monetary amount deposited under the term deposit account/product.
Standard currency code representing the denomination used for the deposit amount.
Classification/type of amount such as principal, maturity, or interest amount.
Date on which the term deposit becomes effective or starts.
Date on which the term deposit tenure ends or expires.
Scheduled maturity date on which the term deposit completes its tenure and becomes payable.
Date on which the term deposit account was originally opened.

events.text: Note: TermDepositDuration.EndDate is sourced from /v1/derived-parameter-values (deposit_period_end_date). This is the only field in the TD SD that requires the derived-parameter-values API.
